invariants: GET navigation creates no default row and returns only current-visible favorites with dense public positions.
PATCH preferences and PUT/DELETE favorites reject missing or unknown top-level JSON keys and use independent zero-based exact CAS versions.
Every new route requires current authentication; unsafe methods additionally require same-origin and CSRF through the existing Notion host middleware.
Missing membership and invisible favorite targets return the same generic no-store 404 envelope.
Every response is no-store and contains no title, body, path, filename, raw public token, lease token, hidden favorite count, or hidden ordinal gap.
The overlay is registered only by app_notion; app_code, the bridge registrar and Second Brain sources were unchanged.
The legacy 59/61/15 contract remains exact while the workspace overlay advances to 12/19/19.
No UI, Recents writer, resolver cutover, feature flag, request/startup migration, live migration, live data access, destructive acknowledgement or continuous worker was added.
